profile.name: Raj Sahoo
profile.headline: AI/ML Software Developer — agentic AI, RAG, and production LLM systems
profile.eyebrow: Agentic AI · LangGraph · RAG · Production LLM Systems
profile.about: I build production AI systems: autonomous LLM agents, multi-agent orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, and real-time automation. At ConstructMind.ai I build a LangGraph agent that reads construction documents and generates full P6 schedules, plus CoCo, a multi-agent assistant for editing them in natural language. Previously at myOnsite Healthcare I shipped a HIPAA-aligned RAG chatbot, a real-time voice AI agent, a call-sentiment analytics pipeline, a CRM MCP server, and a computer-vision proctoring system — all in production.

experience.summary: Building the AI core of a platform that turns construction documents into P6-importable schedules — a LangGraph agent that autonomously plans WBS, activities, and sequencing, plus CoCo, a multi-agent assistant for editing schedules in plain English.
highlights: Built a LangGraph document-reading agent that autonomously generates full construction schedules, and CoCo, a multi-agent system that classifies intent and routes between greeting, read-only Q&A, and schedule-editing agents.

Hardened the agent for production with guardrails (iteration/token budgets, repetition & drift detection, context-window preflight), a sandboxed shell (command denylist, scrubbed env, path-traversal guards), and Anthropic strict-mode structured tool calling.

Parsed and chunked project documents into pgvector embeddings and ran cosine-similarity semantic search to shortlist evidence before LLM verification; paired deterministic engines (critical-path, WBS coding, DCMA validation) with the LLM only where judgment was needed.

experience.summary: Shipped a portfolio of production AI systems for a nationwide healthcare company — spanning conversational AI, real-time voice, call analytics, natural-language database access, and computer vision — and mentored a team of interns building them.
highlights: Built Carevio, a HIPAA-aligned LangGraph chatbot backed by ChromaDB (RAG), Redis, and MongoDB with a semantic cache and smart gpt-4o-mini/o3-mini routing that cut response latency to 1–3s; Dockerized and deployed on AWS EC2.

Built a real-time telephony Voice AI agent (GPT-4o Realtime API + Whisper + ElevenLabs, orchestrated with LangGraph) for appointment scheduling and human-agent escalation, and an automated Whisper+GPT-4 pipeline turning S3 call recordings into per-agent sentiment dashboards.

Deployed a multi-tenant CRM MCP server letting AI assistants query a CRM in plain English (SELECT-only, bcrypt-auth), a YOLOv8n + MediaPipe AI proctoring service, and a ChromaDB+KNN lead-qualification pipeline; mentored and oversaw 10 interns.

projects.title: ConstructMind — Schedule Generation Agent
projects.summary: An autonomous LangGraph agent that reads construction-project documents and generates a P6-importable (XER) schedule end-to-end — planning the WBS, activities, sequencing, calendars, and resources. Pairs a tool-using Claude agent with deterministic critical-path and DCMA validation engines, guardrails, and a sandboxed shell.
whatItDoes: Reads project documents and autonomously plans a full construction schedule
Emits P6-importable XER + structured schedule JSON
Shortlists evidence via pgvector cosine-similarity search before LLM calls
Guardrails: iteration/token budgets, drift & repetition detection, preflight checks
Sandboxed shell (command denylist, scrubbed env, path-traversal guards)
Deterministic CPM / WBS / DCMA engines keep the math reproducible

projects.title: ConstructMind — CoCo Multi-Agent Assistant
projects.summary: A multi-agent LangGraph assistant that lets planners talk to their construction schedule in plain English. A classifier routes each message between a greeting agent, a read-only Q&A agent, and a schedule-editing agent — with a hard read/write boundary and strict-mode structured tool calling for safe edits.
whatItDoes: Classifies user intent and routes to the right specialist agent
Read-only Q&A agent answers schedule questions without mutation risk
A single scoped editing agent applies schema-validated structured edits
Cheap-vs-expensive path selection keeps latency and cost down
Shares production guardrails with the generation engine

projects.title: Carevio AI Chatbot Platform
projects.summary: A HIPAA-aligned production customer-service chatbot for a nationwide healthcare company: a FastAPI + LangGraph backend with ChromaDB RAG, Redis, and MongoDB, a semantic cache, smart gpt-4o-mini/o3-mini routing (1–3s responses), real-time agent escalation, and an admin dashboard. Dockerized on AWS EC2.
whatItDoes: Retrieval-augmented answers grounded in company documents
Semantic cache + smart model routing for 1–3s responses
Real-time human-agent escalation with a live admin dashboard
HIPAA-aligned, Dockerized, deployed on AWS EC2

projects.title: Call Center Sentiment Analysis System
projects.summary: An automated pipeline that ingests call recordings from S3, transcribes them with Whisper, runs sentiment analysis and summarization with GPT-4, stores structured results, and surfaces per-agent performance dashboards and daily AI-generated reports.
whatItDoes: Transcribes and analyzes call recordings automatically
Per-agent sentiment and performance dashboards
Daily AI-generated operational reports

projects.title: CRM MCP Server
projects.summary: A multi-tenant Model Context Protocol server that lets AI assistants query a production CRM in plain English. SELECT-only enforcement, bcrypt-authenticated access, connection pooling — safe natural-language database access.
whatItDoes: Translates natural language into safe, read-only SQL
Multi-tenant, bcrypt-authenticated, SELECT-only enforcement
Production-ready with connection pooling

projects.title: Plant Disease Classification System
projects.summary: A custom 3-block CNN trained from scratch on 87,000+ leaf images across 38 disease categories (14 plant species), reaching 96.57% validation accuracy with a memory-efficient TensorFlow/Keras data pipeline and a real-time inference API.
whatItDoes: 38 disease categories across 14 plant species
96.57% validation accuracy; 96% macro precision/recall/F1
Memory-efficient pipeline over 87K+ images
